name: hazel_weir_velocity_procedural_graph
description: Optimized Procedural Graph featuring capital-velocity liquidations at premium price floors, hyper-fertilized Strawberry compounding on 18-20 plots, strict Town Shop phase-gates, and cluster-harvest workforce routing with formalized fertilizer application.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade, while purging phantom feed reserves on livestock-free farms.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Fulfills active town shop contracts for 2.0x-3.5x premiums. Procures exact seed quantities for active shop demands with strict maturation phase-gates to prevent late-game stranded crops, protecting perennial Strawberry acreage.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) into pre-glut cyclical peaks (>= 1.10x base price) immediately before opponent market gluts collapse prices.

nodes.name: Capital Velocity & Liquidation
nodes.description: Abolishes shed hoarding by executing continuous batch liquidations of uncontracted surplus inventory at favorable market peaks (>= 1.05x base price), unlocking fluid cash for reinvestment while preserving margins.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash into workforce scaling (up to 10-11 hands), calibrated land expansion (18-20 plots max by Day 20), and hyper-fertilized recurring cash crops (Strawberries) for maximum multi-harvest yield compounding.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with cluster harvesting to minimize transit waste. Enforces a strict priority sequence including timely shed drop-offs, watering, planting, and fertilizer application to maximize multi-harvest Strawberry yield compounding.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases; schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of non-feed, non-contract inventory at hour >= 20 to guarantee payroll.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve ((n_animals * 3) if n_animals > 0 else 0); never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (shop_deliverable_inventory > 0 or (net_available_cash >= 180.0 and active_shop_demand > 0)) and day <= 29
attributes.guidance: Allocate market slots to deliver exact matching inventory to town shops for 2.0x-3.5x premium. Procure exact seed quantities strictly to fulfill active shop contracts. Phase-gates: Halt Pumpkin seeds after Day 14, Tomatoes after Day 18, Carrots after Day 25, and all shop seeds after Day 26. Never overwrite or uproot perennial Strawberry plots for shop contracts.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not hoard inventory speculatively for future unrevealed contracts; instantly release uncontracted surplus to open-market liquidation. Do not buy shop seeds if net cash falls below 1.25x midnight payroll.

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) into pre-glut cyclical peaks (1.10x-1.35x base) before opponent dumping collapses market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not dump into already collapsed sub-1.0x base price markets unless shed overflow is imminent; do not front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts. Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve ((n_animals * 3) if n_animals > 0 else 0).

attributes.guidance: Execute batch sales of unreserved, non-shop surplus holdings when market price >= 1.05 * base_price. If shed occupancy >= 75%, relax price floor to 0.80 * base_price to maintain capital velocity.
attributes.pitfalls: Never liquidate exact item quotas reserved for active town shop contracts. Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve ((n_animals * 3) if n_animals > 0 else 0).

attributes.condition: net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.5 + 100.0 and (hired_hands < 11 or uncultivated_plots > 0 or has_fertilizer_deficit) and day <= 28
attributes.guidance: Scale workforce to 10-11 hands. Gate contiguous land expansion to 18-20 plots only when hands >= 8, cash > 2.0x payroll + plot cost, and day <= 20. Transition non-shop acreage to hyper-fertilized Strawberries for maximum multi-harvest yield compounding. Maintain continuous fertilizer procurement for all Strawberry plots.
attributes.pitfalls: Never expand land beyond 20 plots or after Day 20. Do not plant slow single-harvest crops (Pumpkins, Tomatoes) unless explicitly demanded by an active town shop contract. Ensure persistent fertilizer procurement for all Strawberry plots.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch hands using cluster harvesting: workers must harvest adjacent ready plots up to inventory capacity before routing to the shed. Priority sequence: 1) Drop off at shed if inventory full or hour >= 20, 2) Cluster Harvest, 3) Water dry crops, 4) Plant seeds, 5) Apply fertilizer to Strawberry plots, 6) Feed livestock, 7) Weed/Till. Ensure all carried inventory is deposited by step 716.
attributes.pitfalls: Never deprioritize watering below shed transit unless inventory is full. Do not allow 1-crop transit cycles that waste worker steps. Ensure hands never idle while unharvested crops or dry plots remain.
